description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different benchmarks: Audio-Reasoner and Qwen-2.5-Omni, with a third category represented by a gray bar labeled "Audio-Reasoner" on the x-axis, which appears to be a placeholder or mislabeled category. The y-axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For the Audio-Reasoner benchmark, the MMAU model achieves an accuracy of approximately 60%, while the MMAR model achieves around 35%. For the Qwen-2.5-Omni benchmark, MMAU reaches an accuracy of about 65%, and MMAR reaches approximately 55%. The gray bar at the leftmost position, labeled "Audio-Reasoner," has a negligible height, indicating a very low accuracy value, possibly close to 0%. The chart uses blue bars for MMAU and purple bars for MMAR, with a legend in the top-left corner identifying the models. The bars are grouped by benchmark, with MMAU and MMAR shown side-by-side for each category.
